```{r install, eval = FALSE}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "sf", "tigris"))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)   # dplyr, ggplot2, readr, forcats
library(sf)          # simple features: spatial data as a data frame
library(tigris)      # downloads Census TIGER/Line boundary files

# Cache the downloaded boundaries so tigris doesn't re-download every knit
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

## Step 1 — Read the data

The Washington Post file has a few non-UTF-8 characters in victim names, so
`read_csv()` needs to be told the encoding or it will throw a parsing error.

```{r read}
homicides <- read_csv(
  "../data/homicide-data.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "Latin1")
)

dim(homicides)   # 52179 rows x 12 columns
```

Note the `../` in the path: this Rmd lives in `writing/`, so it has to step up one
level to reach `data/`. (Knitting sets the working directory to the Rmd's folder.)
